name: Label Start To Return
source:
Label Start To Return (LSTR) is a point-and-click visual novel developed in Ren'Py. You play as a junior game programmer starting their new career. As time passes, witness the story thicken and manage your time carefully to experience the the main story and other events along the way. Make sure to pay rent. 

[From [url=https://o21-works.itch.io/label-start-to-return]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Label Start To Return》（LSTR）是一部使用Ren'Py开发的点击式视觉小说。你将扮演一名刚开启职业生涯的初级游戏程序员。随着时间流逝，故事逐渐展开；你需要谨慎安排时间，体验主线剧情与沿途发生的其他事件。别忘了交房租。

[摘自[url=https://o21-works.itch.io/label-start-to-return]itch.io[/url]]
